observations.observation: The heading identifies Collegium Decision 4 dated 20 January 2026. Its subject is an extension of the anti-dumping measure concerning welded tubes, pipes and hollow profiles of corrosion-resistant (stainless) steel originating in China and imported into the EAEU customs territory.
Extends the measure established by Collegium Decision 12 of 9 February 2021 through 12 November 2026 inclusive.

Addresses the member states' customs authorities. From entry into force of this decision through 12 November 2026 inclusive, it refers to collection at rates established by Decision 12 of 9 February 2021 under the procedure for collecting provisional anti-dumping duties.
The clause specifies entry into force after 30 calendar days from official publication, but not earlier than 14 March 2026.

observations.observation: Printed publication date is 10 September 2026 and publication identifier is 2026/512/AD30R1.

The notice concerns completion of the expiry review for the welded stainless-steel tube/pipe/hollow-profile measure concerning China. It references Decision 12 of 9 February 2021 and a Collegium decision adopted on 8 September 2026 extending the measure through 7 September 2031.
